# All About Lawyer

> > Comprehensive legal resource platform providing information on family, civil, and consumer law with lawyer directory, Q&A services, and rights education across multiple U.S. jurisdictions.

All About Lawyer serves as a centralized hub for legal education and guidance, covering major practice areas including family law (divorce, custody, adoption), civil law (personal injury, contracts, business), and consumer law (debt, identity theft, product liability). The site combines informational guides with professional legal consultation services to help users understand their rights and find qualified legal representation.

## Key Topics

- Family Law
- Divorce & Spousal Support
- Child Custody & Adoption
- Personal Injury
- Consumer Protection
- Debt & Debt Collection
- Identity Theft
- Contract Law
- Business Law
- Medical Malpractice
- Product Liability
- Truck Accident Liability
- Consumer Rights
- Legal Guidance
- State Jurisdictions (CA, FL, TX, IN)

## Core Resources

- [All About Lawyer](https://allaboutlawyer.com): Homepage offering legal information, lawyer directory, and rights education across multiple practice areas.
- [About Us](https://allaboutlawyer.com/about-us): All About Lawyer mission statement and overview of legal education resources and guidance.
- [Ask A Lawyer](https://allaboutlawyer.com/ask-a-lawyer): Q&A service for basic legal questions answered by qualified lawyers across state jurisdictions.

## Family Law

- [Family Lawyer](https://allaboutlawyer.com/family-lawyer): Family law hub covering divorce, custody, child support, and qualified family lawyer guidance.
- [Divorce](https://allaboutlawyer.com/family-lawyer/family-law/divorce): Guide to divorce laws, procedures, grounds, and legal process in CA and FL jurisdictions.
- [Child Custody](https://allaboutlawyer.com/family-lawyer/family-law/child-custody): Child custody arrangements, legal vs. physical custody, parenting plans, and Indiana law.
- [Alimony](https://allaboutlawyer.com/family-lawyer/family-law/alimony): Alimony basics, spousal support types, calculations, and state-specific laws in CA, TX, FL.
- [Child Adoption](https://allaboutlawyer.com/family-lawyer/family-law/child-adoption): Adoption options, eligibility requirements, process overview, and tax credit information.

## Civil Law

- [Civil Lawyer](https://allaboutlawyer.com/civil-lawyer): Civil law hub covering contracts, personal injury, property law, and business disputes.
- [Personal Injury](https://allaboutlawyer.com/civil-lawyer/civil-law/personal-injury): Personal injury law guide covering negligence, compensation, and victim rights.
- [Business](https://allaboutlawyer.com/civil-lawyer/civil-law/business): Business law guide covering formation, contracts, litigation, and commercial compliance.
- [Contracts](https://allaboutlawyer.com/civil-lawyer/civil-law/contracts): Contract law guide covering clauses, types, negotiation, and breach of contract issues.
- [Property](https://allaboutlawyer.com/civil-lawyer/civil-law/property): Property law guide covering rights, transactions, disputes, and power of attorney.
- [Medical Malpractice](https://allaboutlawyer.com/civil-lawyer/civil-law/medical-malpractice): Medical malpractice law covering negligence, wrongful death, birth injury, and damages.
- [Truck Accident](https://allaboutlawyer.com/civil-lawyer/civil-law/personal-injury/truck-accident): Truck accident liability, FMCSA regulations, damages, and commercial vehicle negligence.

## Consumer Law

- [Consumer Lawyer](https://allaboutlawyer.com/consumer-lawyer): Consumer law hub covering debt, product liability, identity theft, and fraud protection.
- [Identity Theft](https://allaboutlawyer.com/consumer-lawyer/consumer-law/identity-theft): Identity theft protection, fraud detection, consumer rights, and recovery assistance.
- [Debt](https://allaboutlawyer.com/consumer-lawyer/consumer-law/debt): Debt collection laws, consumer rights, wage garnishment, and harassment prevention.
- [Product Liability](https://allaboutlawyer.com/consumer-lawyer/consumer-law/product-liability): Product liability law covering defective products, safety, and manufacturer liability.
- [Debt Consolidation](https://allaboutlawyer.com/consumer-lawyer/consumer-law/debt-consolidation): Debt consolidation options, personal loans, interest rates, and consumer protection.
